name: One Lantern Too Many
summary: Every festival week the children of Vallaki carry paper lanterns round the square for the Baron. Thirty-one children. Thirty-two lanterns.

stages.journal: The town guard says the children carry thirty-two lanterns round the square at the Baron's festivals, and there are only thirty-one children. Old Sabin makes them, at the market.
objectives: Ask Old Sabin about the lanterns
stages.hint: Find Old Sabin by his strings of paper lanterns in Vallaki's streets, by day, and ask about the extra lantern.

stages.journal: Old Sabin's hands make one lantern too many every week, and he doesn't know who for. Last night his grandson Sandu followed the extra one out of the west gate, toward the lake.
objectives: Go to the fishers' jetty on Lake Zarovich after dark
stages.hint: Walk out to the end of the fishers' jetty at the Lake Zarovich landing after dark and watch the lanterns on the water.

stages.journal: At the end of the fishers' jetty was a drowned girl made of lantern light, with Sandu by the hand. She's gone out now.
stages.hint: See to Sandu at the fishers' landing, then take him back to Old Sabin in Vallaki.

stages.journal: Sandu is coming home to his grandfather, cold and alive.
objectives: Take Sandu back to Old Sabin in Vallaki
stages.hint: Old Sabin sits by his strings of paper lanterns in Vallaki's streets by day; bring Sandu to him there.

stages.journal: Sandu is home. Sabin's hands made thirty-one lanterns this week, and he gave us the dream-catcher his daughter made the week before she drowned.
